scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:app
scripts.lint: bun run lint:structure && oxlint -c oxlint.json --type-aware --type-check src/ packages/scene-graph/src/ packages/core/src/ packages/vue/src/ packages/cli/src/ packages/mcp/src/ packages/cloud/src/ packages/dom-css/src/ packages/pen/src/ packages/kiwi/src/ packages/fig/src/
scripts.lint:structure: oxlint -c oxlint.json vite.config.ts vite/ .storybook/ src/ packages/scene-graph/src/ packages/scene-graph/scripts/ packages/core/src/ packages/vue/src/ packages/cli/src/ packages/mcp/src/ packages/cloud/src/ packages/cloud/tests/ packages/dom-css/src/ packages/dom-css/tests/ packages/dom-css/scripts/ packages/pen/src/ packages/pen/scripts/ packages/kiwi/src/ packages/kiwi/tests/ packages/kiwi/scripts/ packages/fig/src/ packages/fig/tests/ packages/fig/scripts/ tests/ scripts/ tools/
scripts.format: oxfmt --write .oxfmtrc.json vite.config.ts vite/ .storybook/ src/ packages/scene-graph/src/ packages/scene-graph/scripts/ packages/core/src/ packages/cli/src/ packages/mcp/src/ packages/cloud/src/ packages/cloud/tests/ packages/cloud/*.ts packages/vue/src/ packages/dom-css/src/ packages/dom-css/tests/ packages/dom-css/scripts/ packages/pen/src/ packages/pen/scripts/ packages/kiwi/src/ packages/kiwi/tests/ packages/kiwi/scripts/ packages/fig/src/ packages/fig/tests/ packages/fig/scripts/ tests scripts/ tools/
scripts.format:check: bun run format && status=$(git status --porcelain -uall) && test -z "$status" || (echo "$status" && exit 1)
scripts.check: bun run check:repo && bun run check:workspaces && bun run check:publishing && bun run check:app
scripts.check:app: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:vue
scripts.check:repo: bun run lint && bun run check:i18n && bun run check:deps && bun run check:audit && bun run check:secrets && bun run check:monorepo && bun run check:arch && bun run test:tools && bun run test:dupes
scripts.check:cloud-policy: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src semgrep/semgrep:1.153.0 semgrep --no-git-ignore --config tools/security/semgrep/cloud.yml --error --metrics=off packages/cloud/src src/app/collab src/app/integrations/storage/cloud
scripts.test:unit:quick: bash -lc 'mapfile -t test_files < <(bun tools/unit-tests/src/list.ts all); bun test "${test_files[@]}"'
scripts.test:unit:heavy: bash -lc 'mapfile -t test_files < <(bun tools/unit-tests/src/list.ts all --heavy-only); bun test --timeout 180000 "${test_files[@]}"'
scripts.test:dupes: jscpd packages/scene-graph/src packages/pen/src packages/core/src packages/cli/src packages/cloud/src packages/dom-css/src src --min-lines 5 --min-tokens 50 --format typescript --threshold 0
scripts.test:publishing: bun run --filter @open-pencil/package-quality-tools check && bun run --filter @open-pencil/package-quality-tools smoke
